jobs_results.title: Data Analyst - Global Partner Ads (They/She/He)
jobs_results.description:
Data Analyst - Global Partner Ads (They/She/He)

Not your usual app. We are the fastest-growing multi-category app connecting millions of users with businesses, and couriers, offering on-demand services from more than 170,000 local restaurants, grocers and supermarkets, and high street retail stores.

We operate in more than 1500 cities across 25 countries. Every year, +200k merchants generate over 4B€ in sales through our platform and over 20M customers get their goods delivered in minutes.

We have a vision: To give everyone easy access to anything in their cities.

And this is where your ride starts…

YOUR MISSION

You will be a key resource to provide revenue and pricing insights and solutions to Glovo’s commercial teams dedicated to distribution of advertising and monetization products. You will use and generate information resources regarding our Partner’s KPIs, historical data, market conditions, and internal margin/revenue targets to prepare revenue forecasts & models... internal proposals regarding pricing and sales strategies for future products/campaigns/seasons/segments.

In this role you will be part of the Partners Team at Glovo HQ, being able to Improve Glovo’s food partners P&L and creating a scalable revenue stream. Working in the Global team you will play a pivotal role for the teams in all our geographies to deliver the Ads & Monetisation business plan contributing directly to the company P&L.

You’ll be part of a new area and have the opportunity to work on new solutions and bring existing ones to the next level.

Experimentation, learning and quick iterations will be part of your daily life.

THE JOURNEY
• Develop and distribute weekly, monthly and quarterly dynamic forecasts of expected revenue results, variances and budget comparisons.
• Develop and maintain the key data data funnels of the Partners ads vertical (i.e. sales , penetration, retention) setting up and support centralized dashboards.
• Deliver growth and profitability models to plan and size business initiatives and investment areas.
• Establish and measure adequate KPIs to assess local performance and determine the effectiveness of the implemented initiatives (e.g., new assets)
• Grow Advertising revenue & maximize profitability by identifying actions, that encourage higher sale values, volumes, conversion rates, margin rates, and customer satisfaction
• Lead revenue-related projects including establishing timelines, defining deliverables, and drafting communications or presentations
• Conduct trainings to ensure all impacted colleagues are fully competent in the use of all tools, processes and insights
• Ensure all related systems are configured correctly, validated and working to full capacity
• Provide guidance and support to business leaders and stakeholders on how best to harness available data in support of critical business needs and goals
• Drive clarity and solve ambiguous, challenging business problems using data-driven approaches
• Own the reporting structure for the commercial team, ensuring our team is both data driven and aligned.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE RIDE
• 2-4 years of professional experience outside of an academic and internship setting, in a quantitative analysis role, preferably in commercial facing teams
• Demonstrated proficiency in working with clean & optimized SQL and python, querying mid to large volumes of data.
• In-depth knowledge of BI tools such as Looker, Tableau, and practical experience analyzing data, program metrics, and performance
• Ability to summarize and represent data (e.g., descriptive statistics and graphs).
• Ability to create robust, insightful, and story-telling visualizations using modern BI & Analytics tools and ability to identify data Issues.
• Familiarity with a collaborative environment and/or version control (GitHub, Git).
• Ability to build hypotheses and test them (sometimes by piloting projects entirely)
• Project management / coordination skills. Determined to get things done
• Understanding of A/B test principles, to design, conduct and analyze different experiments.
• You are eager to learn, hungry for knowledge, and want to work towards growing in your career from day one.
• You are independent in solving problems within your capabilities and proactive in asking for support when the task is beyond your expertise.
• You are not afraid of giving/receiving constant & honest feedback
• Excellent spoken and written English.
• Bachelor in, economics, statistics, math or engineering preferred

PLUS TO HAVE
• Experience within the digital advertising industry and data monetisation

Even if it seems you don't meet our musts don't let it stop you, we are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

We believe driven talent deserves:
• 🌟 An enticing equity plan *if applicable
• 💪 Top-notch private health insurance to keep you at your peak.
• 🍔 Monthly Glovo meal benefits so you can test new features in our beta app (and to satisfy your cravings!)
• 💳 Discounts on transportation, food, and even kindergarten expenses or office-based nursery.
• 🏊 Discounted gym memberships to keep you energized.
• 🏖️ The freedom to work from home two days a week, and the opportunity to work from anywhere for up to three weeks a year. .
• 👪 Enhanced parental leave (*if applicable)
• 🧠 Online therapy and wellbeing benefits

We’ll deliver a non-vanilla culture built on talent, where we work to amplify the impact on millions of people, paving the way forward together.

At Glovo, we truly value diversity for the positive impact it brings to our teams, products, and culture. We're dedicated to providing equal opportunities for talent from all backgrounds.

Feel free to note your pronouns in your application (e.g., she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

Delve into our culture by taking a peek at our Instagram and check out our Linkedin and website

jobs_results.title: Prácticas DATA & BI
jobs_results.description:
ELEVE SU POTENCIAL

Somos un proveedor global de infraestructuras de comunicaciones digitales. Facilitamos a nuestros socios y clientes conectar con más personas, construyendo comunidad y creando oportunidades. En American Tower España operamos más de 11.900 torres en todo el país. Estamos invirtiendo significativamente en la construcción de nuevos emplazamientos para 5G y LTE, y también ofrecemos soluciones innovadoras para ciudades y edificios inteligentes.

En American Tower estamos ayudando a construir un mundo más conectado y estamos buscando personas que quieran elevar su impacto y potencial con nosotros.

Nuestra cultura se basa en la integridad, la responsabilidad, el trabajo duro y la colaboración.

Creemos en la contratación de buenas personas y en su capacitación. Ya se trate del mantenimiento de nuestra infraestructura, la creación de nuevas soluciones o la expansión a nuevos mercados, nuestra gente tiene oportunidades significativas y atractivas para desarrollar las... trayectorias profesionales que mejor se adapten a sus talentos y aspiraciones. Esto les da la oportunidad de crecer profesionalmente, un alto nivel de responsabilidad sobre su trabajo y la satisfacción de poder marcar la diferencia.

DESCRIPCIÓN GENERAL DEL PUESTO:

Participación en el equipo de BPM (Business Process Management) analizando los datos y reportes corporativos, donde adquirirá experiencia práctica en la creación de reportes, utilizando herramientas avanzadas de Oracle, específicamente Oracle Analytics Server (OAS) y Oracle Data Visualization (ODV). Este puesto ofrece una oportunidad única para desarrollar habilidades en análisis de datos y presentación de informes dentro de un entorno corporativo dinámico.

FUNCIONES Y RESPONSABILIDADES:

Creación de Reportes:

Asistir en la generación de reportes corporativos utilizando las herramientas de Oracle OAS y/o ODV.

Colaborar con el equipo para comprender los requisitos de informes y asegurar la entrega oportuna de los mismos.

Participar en la identificación de tendencias y patrones a través del análisis de datos.

Análisis de Datos:

Ayudar en la recopilación, limpieza y transformación de datos para su posterior análisis.

Contribuir en la identificación de insights significativos a partir de los datos recopilados.

Colaborar con otros miembros del equipo en proyectos de análisis de datos más amplios.

Soporte Técnico:

Brindar asistencia técnica básica en la configuración y uso de las herramientas de Oracle OAS y/o ODV.

Participar en la resolución de problemas relacionados con la generación de informes y el análisis de datos.

PERFIL DEL CANDIDATO:

Educación:

Estudiante universitario o recién graduado en áreas relacionadas con la informática, estadística, matemáticas, ingeniería o campos similares.

Experiencia:

No se requiere experiencia previa, pero se valorará positivamente cualquier experiencia relacionada con análisis de datos o gestión de bases de datos y conocimiento de Oracle.

Competencias:

Experiencia/conocimiento en herramientas Office, particularmente Excel a nivel avanzado y conocimientos de SQL a nivel intermedio.

Conocimientos de bases de datos y herramientas de análisis de datos (Webservices, APIs, Formatos XML, JSON entre otros).

Lenguajes de Programación y aplicaciones de transferencia de datos.

Capacidad para trabajar en equipo y comunicarse de forma efectiva en español e inglés.

Habilidad para aprender rápidamente y adaptarse a nuevas tecnologías.

Atención al detalle y capacidad para trabajar de manera organizada en un entorno de ritmo rápido.

Interés en el análisis de datos y el desarrollo de informes corporativos

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst - Certificado Discapacidad
jobs_results.description:
¡Hola Data Lover! 💙

En SDG Group, creemos en el poder de la diversidad y la inclusión.

Estamos comprometidos a brindar oportunidades a personas con algún tipo de discapacidad, y por ello queremos que formes parte de nuestra familia de especialistas en Data & Analytics.

¿Estás preparadx para embarcarte en esta emocionante aventura? con nosotrxs, podrás potenciar todas tus habilidades y capacidades analíticas, tecnológicas y de negocio.

¡Es hora de despegar hacia el futuro mediante el poder de los datos! Únete a nosotros y prepárate para romper las reglas y alcanzar tu mejor versión 🚀✨.

Descubre el poder de SDG: líderes globales en la industria del dato 💥📊

En SDG trabajamos para la mitad de las empresas del IBEX-35, pero también en multitud de compañías internacionales. Gracias al boom de la analítica, estamos en un ritmo constante de crecimiento, y desde 1994 nos hemos convertido en el socio de confianza para empresas que desean maximizar todo el potencial de sus datos.

Si... buscas formar parte de una compañía 100% especializada en #Data & #Analytics, ¡te estamos esperando!

¿Qué nos hace diferentes? 🧐

En nuestros proyectos, los datos y la tecnología son los protagonistas, te formaremos para que puedas trabajar con lo último del mercado (tenemos un área de innovación dónde impulsamos nuevos partnerships con fabricantes tecnológicos y centros de I+D).

Tendrás todas las oportunidades para alcanzar tu mejor versión, con un plan de carrera totalmente personalizado en el que aprenderás por ti mismo y además, contarás con el apoyo del resto de compañerxs.

Tu mismo te marcarás tus propios tiempos, semestralmente hablarás con tu responsable para compartir feedback y nuevos retos, y en base a tus resultados, habrá una revisión salarial.

Somos una gran familia, desde el minuto 1 trataremos de hacerte la vida más fácil. Tanto tus compañerxs como el resto de equipo siempre tendrán una sonrisa y estarán dispuestos a ayudarte y ofrecerte todo su apoyo.

Colaborarás y trabajarás en tu día a día con grandes referentes (técnicos y/o de negocio), estarán encantados de enseñarte todo lo posible y se sentirán orgullosxs de verte crecer.

Con nosotros el Smartwork es posible. Vivirás una forma de trabajo en la que cada uno gestiona su propio tiempo.

Somos una marca con propósito. Creemos que la diversidad y la inclusión ayudan a promover una cultura de creatividad, permitiéndonos superar nuevas situaciones y desafíos.

Metiéndonos un poco más en temas más formales, pero no menos importantes, ofrecemos contrato indefinido, ¡queremos que te quedes con nosotrxs mucho tiempo!, salario competitivo de acuerdo con tú nivel de formación y experiencia (no te preocupes, ya qué, en la primera entrevista, trataremos este aspecto y te informaremos si tus expectativas están alineadas) y te ofrecemos una ayuda económica para gastos ocasionados por el teletrabajo.

Podríamos continuar detallando que nos hace especiales, y nos encantará hacerlo en una llamada telefónica. Por el momento, vamos a mostrarte algunos detalles que estamos seguros que te podrán interesar ✌️

¿Cuál será tu misión? ✍

Te involucrarás en aspectos relacionados con análisis técnicos, transformación de datos y cuadros de mandos de todos proyectos en los que participes. ¿Cómo podrás hacerlo?
• Aprendiendo todo lo posible a nivel técnico y, poco a poco, te haremos ganar confianza en ti mismo e irás contando con la capacidad de gestionar tu propio tiempo y cada vez trabajar con mayor autonomía.
• Te encargarás también de la redacción de la documentación del proyecto en el que participes.
• Participarás en el análisis funcional de los proyectos, lo que te permitirá entender el negocio y tener una visión global y mayor conocimiento de los clientes.

¿Qué te hará triunfar en esta posición? 👇
• Que estés en último curso o hayas finalizado tus estudios en Ingeniería Informática, Telecomunicaciones, Ciencia de datos, Industriales u otra salida académica que te haya dotado de capacidad de desarrollo y pensamiento crítico en este ambiente.
• Contar con un certificado de discapacidad igual o superior al 33%, valoramos la diversidad y queremos ofrecer oportunidades a todas las personas talentosas.
• Valoraremos muy positivamente formación adicional en Analytics, Big Data, o alguna disciplina similar, si no cuentas con ella no te preocupes ya que ¡estamos para aprender!
• Buscamos apasionadxs de los datos con espíritu innovador y muchas ganas de crecer con nosotrxs ya que podrás participar en proyectos que se mueven en entornos cambiantes en los que podrás tener un aprendizaje continuo.
• Capacidad de comunicación de cara a tus compañerxs, es muy importante para nosotrxs que puedas coordinarte con ellxs, apoyarles y levantar la mano para pedir ayuda.
• Cómo trabajamos en un entorno global, ¡será necesario que puedas comunicarte en inglés!

Por último, queremos contarte los pasos de nuestro proceso de selección

En nuestros procesos realizarás 3️ sesiones:
• Primera toma de contacto con nuestra área de People First (donde trataremos temas de crecimiento profesional, banda salarial y definiremos qué áreas se adaptan a ti).
• Segunda sesión técnica donde podrás sorprendernos con todos tus conocimientos y habilidades en entornos tecnológicos (y así poder ofrecerte un proyecto que encaje con tus conocimientos e intereses).
• Reunión con el responsable del equipo en el que te incorporarías para poder solucionar todas las dudas que te hayan podido surgir en el proceso.

¿Has superado todas las fases? ¡Buenas noticias! Recibirás una llamada de People First donde te presentaremos nuestra propuesta para que te unas a nosotrxs, y poder resolverte cualquier duda que tengas al respecto. Cuando nos confirmes que quieres formar parte de la familia SDG, empezaremos a preparar todo para recibirte con mucha ilusión.

¿No te puedes incorporar ahora, pero tienes curiosidad e interés en SDG Group? No te preocupes, puedes realizar ahora el proceso de selección y te tendremos en cuenta en las próximas vacantes que encajen con tu perfil profesional.

INSCRÍBETE AHORA ¡ESTAMOS DESEANDO CONOCERTE

• Que estés en último curso o hayas finalizado tus estudios en Ingeniería Informática, Telecomunicaciones, Ciencia de datos, Industriales u otra salida académica que te haya dotado de capacidad de desarrollo y pensamiento crítico en este ambiente.
• Contar con un certificado de discapacidad igual o superior al 33%, valoramos la diversidad y queremos ofrecer oportunidades a todas las personas talentosas.
• Valoraremos muy positivamente formación adicional en Analytics, Big Data, o alguna disciplina similar, si no cuentas con ella no te preocupes ya que ¡estamos para aprender!
• Buscamos apasionadxs de los datos con espíritu innovador y muchas ganas de crecer con nosotrxs ya que podrás participar en proyectos que se mueven en entornos cambiantes en los que podrás tener un aprendizaje continuo.
• Capacidad de comunicación de cara a tus compañerxs, es muy importante para nosotrxs que puedas coordinarte con ellxs, apoyarles y levantar la mano para pedir ayuda.
• Cómo trabajamos en un entorno global, ¡será necesario que puedas comunicarte en inglés!

Por último, queremos contarte los pasos de nuestro proceso de selección

En nuestros procesos realizarás 3️ sesiones:
• Primera toma de contacto con nuestra área de People First (donde trataremos temas de crecimiento profesional, banda salarial y definiremos qué áreas se adaptan a ti).
• Segunda sesión técnica donde podrás sorprendernos con todos tus conocimientos y habilidades en entornos tecnológicos (y así poder ofrecerte un proyecto que encaje con tus conocimientos e intereses).
• Reunión con el responsable del equipo en el que te incorporarías para poder solucionar todas las dudas que te hayan podido surgir en el proceso.

¿Has superado todas las fases? ¡Buenas noticias! Recibirás una llamada de People First donde te presentaremos nuestra propuesta para que te unas a nosotrxs, y poder resolverte cualquier duda que tengas al respecto. Cuando nos confirmes que quieres formar parte de la familia SDG, empezaremos a preparar todo para recibirte con mucha ilusión.

¿No te puedes incorporar ahora, pero tienes curiosidad e interés en SDG Group? No te preocupes, puedes realizar ahora el proceso de selección y te tendremos en cuenta en las próximas vacantes que encajen con tu perfil profesional.

INSCRÍBETE AHORA ¡ESTAMOS DESEANDO CONOCERTE

jobs_results.title: Risk Data Analyst Senior - Valladolid
jobs_results.description:
Country: Spain

SCF Global Services - CGS is looking for a RISK DATA ANALYST SENIOR, based in our Digital HUB in Valladolid.

WHY YOU SHOULD CONSIDER THIS OPPORTUNITY

At Santander (www.santander.com) we are key players in the transformation of the financial sector. Do you want to join us?

Santander Consumer Finance focuses on business development related to consumer finance products, sales channels and commercial agreements with dealers, vehicle manufacturers or retail distribution establishments, as well as commercial functions associated with direct sales (branches, call centers or digital channels) and indirect sales (through third parties) of consumer finance products.

Santander is proud of being an organization where there are equal opportunities regardless of gender identity, culture and disability. Our mission is to contribute to help more people and business prosper.

What You Will Be Doing

As a Risk Data Analyst Senior, you will ensure risk data quality and information... integrity in the SCF Data Ecosystem having a complete view of the data of different SCF units, ensuring a robust data environment with regards to main uses (RDA, New Default, IFRS9…) as well as adapting to any new use cases (Forbearance, Residual Value…)

We need someone like you to help us in different fronts:
• Familiarity with financial regulatory reporting processes.
• Capability of understanding of the current EBA guidelines on the application of the definition of default and possible iterations over them.
• Provide inputs on the Data Quality status and next steps for the promotion of the Data Model version for each entity.
• Regular communication and feedback to local units and different SCF teams (IT, CDO, Risk etc).
• Participate on the improvement of the Data Quality roadmap with a focus on value generation and ensuring continuous updating.
• Identify inconsistencies and propose improvements /solutions.
• Execute monthly validations within SCF Data ecosystem- Credit Risk data (RDA, IFRS9, New Default…).
• To act as a link between SCF Risk users and Risk Data Science to ensure functional requirements are considered in data extractions.
• Define and implement additional validations for each data model release (additional metrics).

Experience
• Regulatory reporting.
• Data Quality assurance.
• Data management (desirable in Risk).
• Experience in coordination and communication with stakeholders
• Experience in requirements gathering for IT from a functional perspective.
• 4-5 years Experience.

EDUCATION
• Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Economics, or related fields with Data specialization.

Skills & Knowledge
• Capability to understand complex processes.
• Proactivity and analytical skills to improve the processes AS-IS.
• Excel expert.
• Medium finance knowledge and analytical skills.
• Ability to interact with different teams and local units.
• Fluent English, spoken and written.

Other Information
• Familiarity with IFRS9, New Default, RDA or any other Financial Regulations desired.

If you want to know more about us, follow us on https://es.linkedin.com/company/banco-santander

jobs_results.title: Senior Global People Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Together with the Global People Analytics team members in Germany, India and Romania, you will be responsible for the consistent implementation and application of Allianz Technology’s global people data strategy and governance thereof. You will work closely with both global People Product Houses and local colleagues to ensure data quality standards are upheld, as well as ensuring third-party administrators or service providers can and do adhere to these standards. You will play a key role in the realization of the People Function’s target operating model, in the bringing together of user requirements in end-2-end data-, process-, and system-design, ensuring consistency and scalability of implementation, and necessary user trainings for immediate adoption. You will collaborate with local and global teams across Allianz Technology to ensure the required data quality to enable efficient and effective reporting and analysis of workforce developments. It is important for you to get to know... Allianz Technology as a company and its strategic priorities to support the implementation and further development of the People Data Strategy and Governance Framework as well as the People target operating model. You will have the opportunity to contribute to Allianz Group initiatives and other projects with your expertise. You will closely collaborate with Allianz Technology People function Product Owners (Centers of Expertise) and Business Partners, as well as IT functions, service providers and the Allianz Group’s global People & Culture function.

You will
• Oversee data quality in the data flow across global systems and processes following the employee lifecycle in the transition to the target operating model
• Develop & document data maintenance standards in accordance with the People Data Strategy & Governance Framework
• Manage adherence to data quality standards in our global HR Master Platform SuccessFactors with various data administrators
• Work with the People Data Analysts to create transparency on overall people data quality and trends; closely work with stakeholders, and especially the Data Analysts and People Operations teams, to identify and implement changes to the system and/ or process landscape to support data maintenance and quality

Your Skills
• Qualification, Certification and Experiences (education, passed PE, trainings, certificates, special IT skills, languages etc.)
• Excellent university degree/ tertiary qualification in relevant field
• 10+ years (corporate) business experience
• Experience in an international working environment and teams
• Solid understanding of SAP SuccessFactors
• Fluent in both spoken and written English; other languages a plus
• Experience in HR Transformation
• Expertise in controlling activities, experience with people/ workforce data is an advantage
• Methodological & conceptual skills, process engineering
• Analytical thinking & problem solving
• Advanced user of MS Office suite of applications
• Comfortable with compiling, interpreting and reporting on information on a wide range of topics
• Skills and Competencies (functional / technical / methodological / social skills, Allianz competencies)
• Able to work independently as well as engaging with various stakeholders in virtual teams across various continents and cultures;
• Good self-organization, prioritization, time management and communication (written and verbal) skills;
• Able to work to deadlines whilst maintaining quality levels in reporting;
• Good assertiveness, critical thinking and problem-solving skills;
• Customer-service oriented with hands-on mentality;
• Strong analytical skills, high attention to detail and comfortable with new information;
• Good understanding of process maps/ system configuration documentation, to also be able identify missing data/ information from internal customers required to perform processes/ actions;
• Able to manage and understand complex HR-related data and processes.

Your benefits:
• We offer a hybrid work model which recognizes the value of striking a balance between in-person collaboration and remote working incl. up to 25 days per year working from abroad
• We believe in rewarding performance and our compensation and benefits package includes a company bonus scheme, pension, employee shares program and multiple employee discounts (details vary by location)
• From career development and digital learning programs to international career mobility, we offer lifelong learning for our employees worldwide and an environment where innovation, delivery and empowerment are fostered.
• Flexible working, health and wellbeing offers (including healthcare and parental leave benefits) support to balance family and career and help our people return from career breaks with experience that nothing else can teach.

About Allianz Technology

Allianz Technology is the global IT service provider for Allianz and delivers IT solutions that drive the digitalization of the Group. With more than 12,000 employees located in 51 countries around the globe, Allianz Technology works together with other Allianz entities in pioneering the digitalization of the financial services industry.

We oversee the full digitalization spectrum – from one of the industry’s largest IT infrastructure projects that includes data centers, networking and security, to application platforms that span from workplace services to digital interaction. In short, we deliver full-scale, end-to-end IT solutions for Allianz in the digital age.

D&I statement

Allianz Technology is proud to be an equal opportunity employer encouraging diversity in the working environment. We are interested in your strengths and experience. We welcome all applications from all people regardless of gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity and cultural background, age, nationality, religion, disability, or philosophy of life.

Join us. Let´s care for tomorrow.

You. IT

• EXPERIENCIA Y CONOCIMIENTOS NECESARIOS:
• Al menos 2 años de experiencia con SSIS y SQL.
• Debes contar con unos 2 años de experiencia trabajando con Power BI.
• Haber trabajando durante 2 años con Databricks y Data Factory.
• Aproximadamente 2 años de experiencia con Azure DB.
• Al menos 2 años de experiencia con pySpark.
• Experiencia previa con Azure DevOps.
• OTROS DATOS:
• Modalidad de trabajo: 100% remoto desde España.
• Alguno datos sobre nosotros...:

jobs_results.title: Online Data Analyst - Spain
jobs_results.description:
TELUS International AI-Data Solutions partners with a diverse and vibrant community to help our customers enhance their AI and machine learning models. The work of our AI Community contributes to improving technology and the digital experiences of many people around the world. Our AI Community works in our proprietary AI training platform handling all data types (text, images, audio, video and geo) across 500+ languages and dialects.

We offer flexible work-from-home opportunities for people with passion for languages. The jobs are part-time , and there is no fixed schedule. Whoever you are, wherever you come from, come join our global AI community. www.telusinternational.com

We are hiring freelance English and Spanish speaking Online Data Analysts for a project aimed at improving the content and quality of digital maps, which are used by millions of users globally. The job would suit someone who is detail-oriented, likes doing research and has a good knowledge of national and local... geography.

This is a freelance position on a flexible schedule - you can work in your own time whenever work is available. You will be completing research and evaluation tasks in a web-based environment, eg verifying and comparing data, determining the relevance and accuracy of information. You will be provided with guidelines for each task, which need to be followed.

Requirements
• Full Professional Proficiency in English and Spanish
• You must be living in Spain the last 2 consecutive years
• Ability to follow guidelines and do research online using search engines, online maps and website information
• You must have familiarity with current and historical business, media, sport, news, social media and cultural affairs in Spain
• Being open to work across a diverse set of Task Types (e.g. Maps, News, Audio tasks, Relevance)
• Willingness to learn and adapt to changing guidelines and tasks
• Applicants must be 18 years or over.

Working on this project will require you to go through a standard recruitment process (including passing an open book assessment). This is a long-term project and your work will occasionally be subject to quality assurance checks.

Why Join the TELUS International AI Community?
• Earn additional income with flexible hours to fit your lifestyle
• Better work-life balance
• Be your own boss
• Complimentary Well-Being package encompassing a wealth of well-being resources.
• Be part of an online community

Payment

Rate of pay per task is inclusive of reading task guidelines. Payment will be issued in accordance with the terms of the contributor agreement upon successful completion of tasks.

Additional Job Description

We are hiring freelance English & Spanish speaking Online Data Analyst’s for a project aimed at improving the content and quality of digital maps, which are used by millions of users globally. The job would suit someone who is detail-oriented, likes doing research and has a good knowledge of national and local geography.

EEO Statement

At TELUS International, we enable customer experience innovation through spirited teamwork, agile thinking, and a caring culture that puts customers first. TELUS International is the global arm of TELUS Corporation, one of the largest telecommunications service providers in Canada. We deliver contact center and business process outsourcing (BPO) solutions to some of the world's largest corporations in the consumer electronics, finance, telecommunications and utilities sectors. With global call center delivery capabilities, our multi-shore, multi-language programs offer safe, secure infrastructure, value-based pricing, skills-based resources and exceptional customer service - all backed by TELUS, our multi-billion dollar telecommunications parent.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At TELUS International, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity

jobs_results.title: Senior Data & Analytics Consultant
jobs_results.description:
About Incubeta

Incubeta is a digital marketing consultancy with a focus on technology, data, and people. Our specialists build solutions that embrace the power of technology, the truth of data, and a spark of human creativity. We help advertisers, agencies, and publishers get the most from digital for their business.

As Google’s most experienced EMEA Sales Partner we have overseen hundreds of deployments across the Google Marketing Platform. We address ad tech infrastructure, data management, integration, and media management and provide clients with relevant and up-to-date digital marketing services and consultancy.

Established in 2001, with 22 offices in 18 countries, we are part of the Incubeta group. A global partnership of leading digital technology, media, and creative specialists. Together, we are experts in end-to-end digital advertising services and media solutions.

The Position

Are you the Data & Analytics rockstar we are looking for? Join our team in Madrid and help us... to grow the analytics service by revolutionizing digital analytics within the Southern Europe market!

We are looking for an experienced Data & Analytics Consultant who will provide detailed solutions to achieve maximum conversion and increase turnover for the business.

As part of the Data & Analytics team, you actively participate in the projects carried out by Incubeta. These projects cover a wide range of services, including data collection, data analysis, dashboarding, CRO, and Cloud 4 Marketing projects. You will also actively participate in the Data & Analytics offers.

Reporting to the Consulting Manager, you will help prioritize web analytics requests, tasks & deliverables according to business needs across different Industries. This is an exciting time to join as our Data and Analytics team is going through a big period of growth.

Role and Responsibilities
• Lead the promotion of Data / Analytics Marketing maturity framework to our clients
• Ensure the quality of deliverables sent to the client. (Analysis, presentations, etc..)
• Follow a structured action plan punctuated by various milestones.
• Ensure data quality & accuracy.
• Oversee operational and technical implementation with junior profiles or data engineers / data scientists
• Address issues related to digital activity management using key performance indicators.
• Guide clients in optimizing website conversion through analysis and optimization of online media purchasing.
• Provide data analysis services for clients, focusing on industry-specific indicators in areas such as travel, telco, retail, financial services etc.. to ensure alignment with their business objectives.

Your character
• A minimum of 2 years of experience in Data / Analytics Marketing or digital marketing within a consulting firm (strategy, organization, IT, etc.), a Business Intelligence solutions provider, or directly with the advertiser.
• Business acumen
• You are passionate about technology and how it can shape the online advertising industry & ecosystem to the benefit of our customers,
• You feel comfortable communicating both internally and with our customers
• Proven expertise in online acquisition channels: search engines (SEO, SEM, bid-management tools), display ads, email marketing, social media, AdExchange, mobile apps, and more.
• Analytical mindset, coupled with exceptional written and oral communication skills.
• You have a proactive & cooperative approach to problem-solving,
• You are able to translate customer needs and deliver a high level of customer satisfaction,
• You are able to work independently whilst being able to work in a diverse cross-functional team,
• You are autonomous in your work and projects,
• You have a knack for finding innovative solutions,
• You want to keep learning and developing your expertise

Your profile
• Minimum 2 - 3 years experience working on digital analytics projects, especially Google Analytics (Universal Analytics and GA4).
• University Degree in Engineering, Economics, Business Administration, or Marketing.
• Fluent in Spanish and good knowledge of business English (Portuguese & Italian are a plus)
• Sound understanding of the Southern European and specific Spanish online advertising industry - knowledge of the underlying technology, major tech providers, agencies landscape, and online media buying & selling processes including the programmatic buying landscape,
• Ability to code/script in support of customer requirements (SQL and/or Javascript and/or Python)
• Experience in designing and building solutions with ETL, TMS, Web Analytics tools, etc.
• Strong in strategic analysis and profound advisory skills,
• Proven track record of successful business development gained at a media agency or advertiser level,
• Proven expert knowledge in Google Analytics 360,
• Strong understanding of all digital marketing channels, ad technologies, cross-media solutions,
• Advanced project management skills,
• Knowledge of Analysis techniques applied to Marketing. Google Cloud knowledge is a plus.

Benefits of working with us
• Working with exciting clients and worldwide enterprise companies alike
• Multilingual and multicultural teamwork
• Freedom to be authentic
• Ownership and accountability for all your projects
• Awesome colleagues & awesome clients
• An international, fast-paced job with attractive professional development opportunities
• Opportunity to grow in a startup environment
